name: SK_Goblin_Hammer_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

rig.rest_pose: standing pose as modelled (not a T pose)
rig.animation: none: skeleton and skin weights only; no clips, no Physics Asset, no control rig
rig.skeleton: bespoke (CONVENTIONS.md section 11: any skeleton with a single root bone named root)

pivot: feet: armature origin on the ground between the feet, front on -Y
dresses: goblin with a war hammer, 1.37 m: green warty skin, brown tunic and breeches, leather skullcap, a square-headed iron hammer on a 1.1 m shaft in the right hand
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound to any placement
known_weaknesses: NOT photoreal at 1 m: a fused blob figure. Clothing is the body surface puffed out and recoloured by region, not separate garments, so there are no hems, belts, buckles or layered edges; the face is pressed-in eyes and mouth with ball eyes and two tusks, without lids or nostrils. Hands are mittens: the weapon passes through the fist. Helmet, weapon and shield are skinned by nearest bone with the same automatic weights as the body (they should be rigid attachments on sockets). Decimated game mesh without joint loops; one test pose; no animation clips, no Physics Asset. Rest pose is a standing guard pose, not the A pose of the Manny skeleton.
skeleton_note: bone names and hierarchy of the project humanoid core set (CONVENTIONS.md section 11), goblin proportions
